Install and remove

A. apk

Dependencies come along, signatures checked:

apk add ros2
apk add ros2=0_git-r4   # this version

apk del ros2   # also drops dependencies nothing else needs

Package: ros2-0_git-r4.apk. Setting up apk: INSTALL.md 2A.

B-1. oss-get

No apk: target/oss-get downloads, checks the SHA-256, installs the dependencies first and keeps a file list per package:

oss-get update
oss-get install ros2
oss-get install ros2=0_git-r4   # this version

oss-get remove ros2   # its files only

Its dependencies stay installed: benchmark, console_bridge, curl, cyclonedds, fastcdr, fastdds, libyaml, lz4, opencv, orocos-kdl, python3, sqlite, tinyxml2, urdfdom, yaml-cpp, zstd. Remove them too (oss-get remove <dep>) if nothing else needs them; oss-get refuses a package another installed one still needs.

B-2. By hand

Archive
https://github.com/openqnx/oss/releases/download/packages-8.0-x86_64-m-z/ros2-0_git-r4.tar.gz (48.5 MiB)
SHA-256
af24bd44498246ef23070508fffcd29a3020b4d5f7936a6d040b250c81e643c3
Install first
benchmark, console_bridge, brotli, c-ares, nghttp2, openssl, zlib, zstd, curl, cyclonedds, fastcdr, foonathan_memory, tinyxml2, fastdds, libyaml, lz4, opencv, orocos-kdl, bzip2, expat, gdbm, libiconv, libunistring, ncurses, gettext, libffi, readline, sqlite, xz, python3, urdfdom, yaml-cpp (in this order, each from its own page the same way; skip any already installed)

Install: download, check, save the file list, unpack under /data/oss:

mkdir -p /data/oss/dl /data/oss/var/lib/manual && cd /data/oss/dl
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/openqnx/oss/releases/download/packages-8.0-x86_64-m-z/ros2-0_git-r4.tar.gz
[ "$(openssl dgst -sha256 ros2-0_git-r4.tar.gz | sed 's/.*= *//')" = af24bd44498246ef23070508fffcd29a3020b4d5f7936a6d040b250c81e643c3 ] && echo OK || echo BAD
gzip -dc ros2-0_git-r4.tar.gz | tar -tf - | grep -v '/$' > /data/oss/var/lib/manual/ros2.list
gzip -dc ros2-0_git-r4.tar.gz | (cd /data/oss && tar -xf -) && rm ros2-0_git-r4.tar.gz

Remove: delete exactly the files it installed, then the list:

cd /data/oss && while read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done < var/lib/manual/ros2.list
rm var/lib/manual/ros2.list

Its dependencies stay installed: benchmark, console_bridge, brotli, c-ares, nghttp2, openssl, zlib, zstd, curl, cyclonedds, fastcdr, foonathan_memory, tinyxml2, fastdds, libyaml, lz4, opencv, orocos-kdl, bzip2, expat, gdbm, libiconv, libunistring, ncurses, gettext, libffi, readline, sqlite, xz, python3, urdfdom, yaml-cpp. Remove each the same way, from its own page, if nothing else needs it.

For a root shell on the target (QNX sh and the stock curl, openssl, gzip, tar; https needs SSL_CERT_FILE, see INSTALL.md). Empty directories stay. Don't remove a dependency another installed package still needs. Use one method per /data/oss: apk and oss-get do not know about files unpacked by hand.
